Folks — draft attached: pricing-ladder-v1.xlsx. High-level proposal:

- Tier A (>= $500k ARR equivalent over 12 months): List price - 28% -> Committed unit price gives ~35% uplift vs pay-as-you-go economics.
- Tier B (>= $250k): List price - 20%
- Tier C (>= $100k): List price - 12%

Channel margin: recommend we reserve up to 18% reseller margin for BrightBridge for this anchor deal, conditional on a named reseller clause and reseller tax id on the PO. Higher margins erode our committed economics; above 18% would require an uplift on CloudWave commit.

Notes/asks:
- Naomi, confirm if our invoicing path supports pass-through to BrightBridge (invoice to CloudWave but line-item showing reseller margin) or if finance needs a separate settlement flow.
- Irene, does SOC/PCI evidence change requirements for channel carve-outs?

If CloudWave accepts the ladder + 18% channel margin, we can build the Private Offer with those bindings.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
